Corollary 3.6. Under P0[ · | Al], the variables (Xτk −Xτk−1, τk)k≥1 are an independent family.
Furthermore, (Xτk −Xτk−1, τk)k≥2, under P0[ · | Al] are identically distributed as (Xτ1 −X0, τ1)
under P0[ · | Al].
On an intuitive level, the idea behind the proof of Corollary 3.6 is that the environments
that the walk sees between diﬀerent renewal times are i.i.d., which can then be transferred to
the behavior of the walk itself.
